meaning: 'verified' means an independent reader attested every item against the source. It does not upgrade any compliance claim, and the script cannot prove the reader's independence - it records the attestation.

verifier.statement: I extracted all 126 source pages directly with pdf.js (text, font faces, text matrices and link annotations), compared every heading, table cell, list item, link, emphasised span and page's text against the rebuilt HTML with normalisation-tolerant scripted matching in both directions, re-verified every flagged item by targeted probes (font/geometry level), independently recomputed the EIC and Tax Table part ranges and row integrity (3,442 body rows), and visually read 26 rendered pages in full plus all 126 as rendered thumbnails, including the page-63 figure, page 118-119 Tax Topics, and the page-126 address table. 19 discrepancies recorded; everything else verified against the source or covered by an explicit review-note disclosure.
